envelope.description: Add LogTailSeam + injectable LogTailFs + the polling-ticker LiveLogTailFs

body.title: Add LogTailSeam + injectable LogTailFs + the polling-ticker LiveLogTailFs
body.summary: New debug/LogTailSeam.kt: interface LogTailFs{listSegments(dir,stem):List<Path>; readLines(file):List<String>; watch(dir,onEvent):AutoCloseable} + class LogTailSeam(fs=LiveLogTailFs, logDir=defaultLogDir(), maxLines=TAIL_MAX_LINES=500){ fun tail(category, onLines):AutoCloseable } mirroring the CLI tailLogWith: active segment = highest-N `<stem>.<N>.log` (regex `^<stem>\.(\d+)\.log$` sorted by N), initial emit = last maxLines, append-only via `seen`, truncation (<seen) re-tails from 0, rotation resets seen, NEVER throws (per-call guards + empty-initial-emit+quiet-retry), idempotent close() with a disposed guard. defaultLogDir()=/tmp/.insrc (mirrors PATHS.logDir, NOT ~/.insrc). LiveLogTailFs binds java.nio (Files.list+name regex, Files.readAllLines drop-trailing-empty) with a FIXED-INTERVAL POLLING-TICKER watch (a ScheduledExecutorService ~1s that stats the active segment + fires onEvent on a size change; each tick catch-all -> skipped tick; cancelled on close — the resolved watch decision, no WatchService). Resolve at build the plugin-available scheduler (AppExecutorUtil.getAppScheduledExecutorService() or a plain ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor).
acceptanceChecks: tail() resolves the highest-N segment, emits the last maxLines initially, then append-only fresh lines; truncation re-tails from 0; a new higher-N segment resets seen; never throws
close() is idempotent and a disposed guard suppresses any post-dispose emit; a throwing LogTailFs still cannot crash tail()

defaultLogDir() is /tmp/.insrc (mirrors PATHS.logDir, distinct from OrphanProcessSeam ~/.insrc/daemon); LiveLogTailFs is read-only (list/read/poll only, no write/rotate/clear) and its polling ticker is cancelled on close
